description: Return a page of FINISHED items of a batch job (one record per item: seq, url, external_id, status, error, and content, or a `result_url` API path (GET /v1/batch/{id}/tasks/{seq}/content, same key) for large bodies). Unfinished items are not listed yet. Returns `{ results: [...], next_cursor? }`; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page. Results expire after the job's retention window (410 Gone).

job_id.description: The batch job id returned by spicrawl_batch_submit or spicrawl_batch_list.

status.description: Only items that finished with this status.

name: spicrawl_batch_results

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last page.

results.description: Finished items of the job, in seq order.

attempts.description: How many times the item was tried.

bytes.description: Response size recorded for this item.

credits_micro.description: Micro-credits charged for this item (0 unless succeeded).

duration_ms.description: Time spent on the item's final attempt, in milliseconds.

code.description: Stable machine error code; switch on this, not on text.

retryable.description: True when running the item again may succeed.

error.description: Why the item failed. Absent on success.

external_id.description: The external_id supplied for this item, if any.

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 time the item reached its terminal status.

http_status.description: The target site's HTTP status (absent when no response was received).

request_id.description: Id of the underlying request, for request history.

bytes.description: Full size of the stored payload in bytes.

content.description: The item's document as raw JSON text (JSON-decode once to get the markdown, text or html). A prefix when truncated.

omitted.description: True when no content was included because the page's size budget was spent; use a smaller `limit`.

truncated.description: True when `content` is only a prefix.

unavailable.description: Why the payload could not be read at all.

result.description: The payload inline. Absent while the job is running or when the item has none.

result_url.description: API path to fetch this item's content on its own.

seq.description: 0-based position in submission order; use it with spicrawl_batch_task_content.

status.description: Terminal item status: succeeded, failed, cancelled or skipped.

title: Read a batch job's results
